item_name: Rothco Deluxe Marines Eagle, Globe & Anchor Low Pro Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco Deluxe Marines Eagle, Globe & Anchor Low Pro Insignia Cap is made from a durable 100% brushed cotton twill, featuring a raised 3-D embroidered Globe & Anchor insignia on the front panel and brim.
